describes: packages/plugin/stage: the six change hooks and the diffing dispatch behind them.

cases.name: change-hooks
cases.covers: Every write goes through the diffing dispatch: the viewport, camera, zoom (with its mode), page and settings hooks fire for what the write changed, in that order; a re-clamp in place on an unbounded stage keeps the camera object and fires no camera event; a throwing listener is swallowed without stopping its siblings; an unsubscribed listener hears nothing more.

cases.name: motion-ended
cases.covers: onMotionEnded fires when a tween, a zoom-anchored tween or a fling settles, and when stopMotion halts a running one; stopMotion with nothing running is silent.

cases.name: an-unbounded-landing-keeps-the-camera
cases.covers: On an unbounded stage a fling lands with setCam(cam()), which keeps the camera object: the last frame fires no camera event, then onMotionEnded does.
